question: How long does it take to sell a house in Chesapeake, VA?
answer: The median home that sold in Chesapeake, VA was on the market 18 days before going under contract, from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026. 44% sold in 14 days or less, and 14% took more than 60 days. Closing typically takes additional time after the contract.
answer_short: Median 18 days on market; 44% sold within 14 days.
description: Chesapeake VA homes took a median of 18 days to sell, per 7,291 closed REIN MLS sales. See how pace varies by price and what sellers can do.
body:
Days on market counts the days from listing to going under contract. For Chesapeake, the median was 18 days across 7,291 closed sales (November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026); the middle half of homes took between 5 and 41 days. That does not include the weeks it usually takes to close after a contract is signed.

Why Some Homes Sell Faster

Pricing is the biggest lever: homes priced to recent comparable sales draw the most early attention. Condition, photography and the season matter too. Homes that sit past the first few weeks often need a price or presentation change. Chesapeake sellers can see how fast individual neighborhoods move in the neighborhood guides below.

The median Chesapeake home sold at 100.0% of its list price. 37% sold above list price and 4% sold at least 5% below it, so outcomes varied widely.
faqs: Do homes in Chesapeake sell above asking price?
37% of Chesapeake homes sold for more than their list price and 4% sold at least 5% below it, per REIN MLS closed sales (November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026).
